values.note: 2026 Diamond Lake: electric site $25 Mon-Wed (non-holiday) / $30 Thu-Sun, water/electric $31 / $36, full hookup $36 / $41; rustic $15 / $20 (left out of the base); cabins $74-79. 21-day and seasonal rates ($1,850-2,050 a season) too. One rate for everyone; a county Motor Vehicle Permit is required for entrance: $8 a day, $24 for 3 days, $35 a year (Newaygo County residents only). $5 reservation fee per reservation.

fees.source: https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/diamond-lake-park/ (Rates & Fees: Nightly (Th-Su) / Nightly (M-W) Non-Holiday: Full-hookup $41 / $36, Water/Electric $36 / $31, Electric $30 / $25, Rustic $20 / $15) + https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/rates-fees/ ('2026 Rates and Fee', 'Newaygo County Parks Motor Vehicle Permits(MVP) is required for entrance. Daily MVP- $8', 'Annual MVP- $35 (Newaygo County Only)', 'Reservation Fee- $5 per reservation'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/diamond-lake-park/ ('24 are full hook-up (water, sewer, and electric)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 60 campsites: 24 full hookup, 36 electric (the rate card also prices water/electric and rustic sites); 4 camping cabins. Seasonal campsites by waiting list.

sites.source: https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/diamond-lake-park/ ('The campground currently offers 4 camping cabins, 60 campsites, 24 are full hook-up (water, sewer, and electric), and the remaining 36 sites are electric', 'Seasonal campsites are available through a waiting list system'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Online (Firefly) or by phone, (231) 689-7340 or the campground in season; 2026 bookings opened January 5 at 9 am. Paid in full at booking.

booking.source: https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/park-reservations/ ('You can make reservations in the following ways on or after January 5, 2026, at 9 am: Over the phone at (231) 689-7340 or the campground during the season', 'With our online system FireFly Reservations') + https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/rates-fees/ ('payments are due in full at the time the reservation is made'), read 2026-10-22

note: Newaygo County park on Diamond Lake; drive-in grass/paved sites, big-rig OK. Swimming beach, hiking trails, horseshoes and beach volleyball, nearby boat launch. --Claude
summary: County pages (2026): electric $25-30, W/E $31-36, full hookup $36-41 (stored 25-41 confirmed), plus a $5 reservation fee and a required Motor Vehicle Permit ($8/day; both added); 60 sites (24 FHU, 36 electric) + 4 cabins, seasonal sites by waiting list (count not given); showers, dump; season May 1-Oct 11 confirmed; Firefly or phone booking. Amperage not stated. Phone (231) 689-1190 is the in-season campground line (off-season (231) 689-7340). Dropped site counts, season and booking text from the note.
